clues.text: A ruler had John the Baptist arrested, bound and put in prison because of this woman, Philip's wife.
John the Baptist kept telling the king it was not lawful for him to have this woman, his brother's wife.
This woman held a grudge against John the Baptist and wanted to kill him.
John the Baptist rebuked the tetrarch over this woman and over all the other evils he had done.
This woman's chance against the Baptist came at the king's birthday banquet for the leading men of Galilee.
At the king's birthday banquet, this woman's daughter danced and pleased him and his guests.
When her daughter asked what to request from the king, this woman answered, "The head of John the Baptist."
